mutations.why: The exemption itself. With the prefix test always false every kind/ issue falls back onto the no-execution-profile worklist - the exact #37 defect, restored. Proves the exemption is doing the work rather than some incidental property of the stub fixtures.

mutations.why: The replacement check is the whole reason the exemption is defensible. Making it unreachable turns the exemption into the free pass #37 warned against, while every other assertion stays green - so this isolates the completeness half from the exemption half.

mutations.why: The field request is invisible to every output-shaped test, because the stub runner returns its fixture regardless of what was asked for. Against real gh this is the difference between a correct audit and one that reports all six epics childless. Same class of defect as v0.3-s1's absent --limit, and caught the same way.
